text:
elaine (PM): quick idea — want to align on a long‑range initiative: platform isolation guardrails + routing policy matrix for multi‑region + multi‑tenant. goal: clear launch criteria so sales/ops can sell with confidence. TL;DR: propose 3 tiers (shared, isolated‑slices, dedicated) with routing precedence, failover, and SLA bands.

maria (Arch): sounds good. can you list the hard constraints? e.g., data residency, latency caps, cross‑region failover expectations.

sam (Eng-runtime): hardware note — isolated‑slices implies pinned GPU pools or strong tenant affinity; batching and KV cache blowups if we cross‑match tenants in same pool. cost delta will be non‑trivial.

tyler (Sales): customers keep asking for "isolation" that means both data residency and noise isolation. revenue qualifier: >$50k ARR gets preferential lane. need clear checklist to include in SOW.

priya (SRE): operationally we need playbooks for eviction, cutover, and throttling. also: what are SLOs per tier? we can’t have ad‑hoc definitions.

john (Security): add: KMS boundaries and audit log retention must be explicit for isolated and dedicated. private deployments may need HSM integration.

elaine (PM): agreed — draft acceptance criteria below, feedback welcome.

Acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Tier definitions: Shared / Isolated‑Slice / Dedicated (one‑line semantics)
- Routing policy doc: precedence, fallback order, cross‑region mapping
- SLA bands: latency p95 & availability targets per tier
- Data residency & KMS mapping table per region
- Launch tests: chaos cutover, tenant surge test, billing reconciliation
- Sales gating: revenue threshold + security review

maria (Arch): +1: do we have an initial policy DSL sketch? need to translate to routing engine config.

sam (Eng-runtime): i can spin a strawman DSL by EOD tomorrow. will include knobs for affinity, max‑batch‑size, kv‑cache‑ttl.

tyler (Sales): can we encode "revenue threshold" as a flag so billing can auto‑assign capacity? else too manual.

priya (SRE): also add long‑tail mitigation: auto‑fallback to shared with rate‑limit & degraded SLA instead of outright failure.

john (Security): noted — HSM & KMS mapping will be in the security checklist. need timeline for private deploy certs.

elaine (PM): action items: sam -> DSL strawman (due tomorrow), maria -> mapping to routing engine (next week), priya -> ops playbook skeleton, john -> security checklist for tiers, tyler -> sales gating language. i'll collate and run through leadership triage on Friday. please react with :white_check_mark: when you ack.

maria (Arch): ack :white_check_mark:

sam (Eng-runtime): ack :white_check_mark:

tyler (Sales): ack :white_check_mark: will prep language for SOW

elaine (PM): thanks — keeping this thread as the canonical convo for the initiative. will upload a short spec once I collect these pieces.
